title: Randomness & Simulation
topicSummary: Inclusive equally likely RANDOM integer outcomes; repeated calls; probability versus finite observed frequencies; simple coin/die simulations, assumptions, usefulness and limits.
homeworkInstructions: 12 original questions, 30 teacher marks, about 45 minutes. Q5 requires exactly TWO choices. Show predictions, traces and reasons. Braces mark blocks; each statement is on its own line.
